messages:
Ana (People Ops): Quick heads-up — handback week starts Monday EOD PT. A few process clarifications about attaching manager notes, timezone reviewer swaps, and last-minute exceptions. Short checklist below.

Mike (Eng Manager): Thanks. For swaps: if a reviewer can't make it, can a peer cover without manager approval?

Sara (People Ops): Short answer: yes for swap within same band + same timezone. If crossing bands or >24h late, manager approval required. Use this form: https://rwd.in/review-swap (cc people-ops).

Mike (Eng Manager): Got it. Cutoff?

Sara (People Ops): Cutoff: 72h before handback closes for automatic swap. After that it's manual and we may move dates. For timezone fairness we prefer swapping within reviewer pool. See checklist: 

```
Checklist for manager/reviewer handoffs:
- Attach manager notes as PDF in the "attachments" field.
- If reviewer is remote (UTC+8/9/10), mark availability window.
- For swaps: include original reviewer, proposed reviewer, reason, and manager sign-off (if cross-band).
- Emergency extension: submit LOA/extension form + notify people-ops@redwood.com
- Calibrations: include 3 anchor examples with comments.
```

PR-Bot: Reminder: Review handback window opens Mon 9:00 PT — automated reminders will ping reviewers 48h and 6h before close.

Jorge (IC): Ana/Sara — I'm going on 3-week caregiving leave starting Thu. Can I request the reviewer assigned to my direct reports be swapped? Need them covered.

Ana (People Ops): Yes. For caregiver LOA we can reassign. Please submit swap form and LOA proof link, and tag me. We'll prioritize and create manual extension if needed. Manager should send a short note in thread.

Mike (Eng Manager): Will do. Also, calibration — any sample anchors we can reuse?

Sara (People Ops): Two brief anchors we recommend to paste into calibration doc:
- 'Above: Consistently delivers projects ahead of schedule, mentors peers, and improves team's best practices with measurable impact.'
- 'Meets: Reliable delivery on scope, occasionally mentors others, meets quality expectations.'
I'll drop a small doc after this thread.

Mike (Eng Manager): Thanks, saved the anchors.

Jorge (IC): Thx. Submitted swap form and LOA doc — form ref #8237.

Ana (People Ops): Got it — we'll process and confirm by tomorrow EOD PT. If anyone needs an emergency handback extension, ping me directly.
